title: Tom and His Ball
text:
Tom is a little dog. He has a red ball. Every morning, Tom runs to the park with his ball. He likes to play with his friend, Mia.

One day, Tom loses his ball under a big tree. He is sad. Mia helps him look for it. After a few minutes, they find the ball in the grass. Tom is very happy.

questions.text: Where does Tom lose his ball?
Why does Mia help Tom look for the ball?
options: Because she wants to keep the ball
Because she is angry with him

questions.text: What can you say about Tom and Mia?
options: They are close friends who help each other
They do not know each other

vocabulary.definition: a public place with grass and trees where people go to play or relax
a person you know well and like
a round object that you throw, kick or hit
the green plant that covers the ground

paragraph_translations: Tom é um cachorrinho. Ele tem uma bola vermelha. Todas as manhãs, Tom corre para o parque com a sua bola. Ele gosta de brincar com a sua amiga, Mia.
Um dia, Tom perde a bola debaixo de uma árvore grande. Ele está triste. Mia ajuda Tom a procurá-la. Depois de alguns minutos, eles encontram a bola na grama. Tom está muito feliz.
